headline: A tech company needed a corporate shell that could actually keep up with how it worked.
challenge: Technology ventures scale fast and handle user data from day one, so the corporate and compliance groundwork has to be built for speed without cutting corners.
delivered: Company incorporation structured for a technology operating model
Data protection policy drafting and compliance documentation
Business analytics framework to support data-led decision-making
Advisory support on regulatory obligations for digital service providers
impact: A technology business with the corporate, data-governance and analytical foundation to grow without having to retrofit compliance later.
